cases.oracle: Independent Linux sched_getscheduler/sched_getparam and sched_setattr on explicitly owned tasks, util-linux chrt comparisons, exact child argv and real wait status, and same-shell /proc policy snapshots. Only real scheduler calls are used.
cases.comparison: Setup checks uid-2000 without CAP_SYS_NICE and RLIMIT_RTPRIO 0, verifies owned three-thread target identity, confirms util-linux single-thread/all-thread BATCH and reset-on-fork behavior, tests real OTHER/BATCH/IDLE child scheduling and an independent kernel DEADLINE EINVAL/EPERM control. The candidate exercises only remembered owned tasks; stdout/stderr, process identities, per-thread policy, child argv and statuses are retained. Privileged FIFO/RR/DEADLINE success is not simulated or claimed.
cases.purpose: Command-form normal policies, arguments, invalid priorities, child statuses and parent policy.
cases.stdout: chrt-command other=yes batch=yes idle=yes reset=yes args=yes exit-signal=yes invalid=yes privileged-deny=yes parent=yes
